notes.title: Patch 2 is Live!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="r9u3uLX2M-s;full"][/previewyoutube]Second Patch
We’ve been hard at work expanding and refining Upin & Ipin Universe to make your adventures more exciting and smoother than ever. Patch 2 introduces brand-new content, important fixes, and long-awaited quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

Fresh Merdeka Content – Merdeka-themed decorations across Kampung Durian Runtuh and Firework Celebration by Tok Dalang.

Streamer Mode – Added a Streamer Mode under the Gameplay Settings.

Gameplay Fixes – From RC collisions to quest markers, we’ve addressed multiple issues.

UI Improvements – Cooking and Fishing activity UIs now function seamlessly.

Quality-of-Life – Basic cooked dishes inventory added, improved save slots, and smoother quest flow.

No matter how you play fishing, racing, cooking, or completing quests this update makes your journey better than ever.


Please check out the full patch notes below. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684481/8d79efca91639c6d2da59469a1d1218741008ae2.jpg"]
Patch 2 Notes – Steam
New Content
Merdeka Celebration

Added new Merdeka-themed decorations across Kampung Durian Runtuh.

Added Firework Celebration by Tok Dalang. 

Streamer Mode

Implemented a dedicated mode for streamers under the Gameplay Settings.

Gameplay & Quest Fixes
Quest Flow

Fixed Quest markers for certain quests now display correctly.

Fixed Errand no longer blocks the opening of the pause menu.

PPP can now be replayed without blockers after leaving it unfinished.

RC Car Racing

Fixed RC car collision issues for smoother multiplayer play.

Gasing Preview

Fixed Player 1 first-time preview issue with the gasing activity.

UI & Controls
Cooking

Fixed UI issues for cooking activity.

Fishing

Fixed Fishing activity UI for Player 2.

Fixed issue where players could still interact with objects while the fishing bait menu was open.

Systems & Inventory
Save Slots

Improved save slot functionality and stability.

Basic Inventory

Added a cooked dishes to inventory system for players.

Map & Visuals
Map Details

Fixed disappearance of map details.

General Fixes & Polish
Overall bug fixes and refinements based on community feedback and testing.


Note: Existing progress and saved data remain unaffected.

Thank you for playing and supporting Upin & Ipin Universe! Keep sharing your feedback, it helps us make the game even better.

notes.title: Patch 1 is Live!
notes.notes:
First Patch
 
We’ve been listening to your feedback and working hard to bring you a smoother, more enjoyable experience in Upin & Ipin Universe. Patch 1 delivers a variety of improvements, bug fixes, and polish to make your adventures even better!  Here’s what’s new: - Better visuals & lighting – Nighttime scenes now look more atmospheric, with smoother motion and 
reduced ghosting.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684481/b9ef410c7340238d50621c0e5c42ffa4bb6029f3.jpg"]- Gameplay fixes – Improved bike controls, RC racing updates, and more!
- Quest adjustments – “Chef Ehsan” quest is now easier to master.
- Bug fixes – From animations to trophies, we’ve tackled player-reported issues.



Whether you’re racing RC cars, completing quests, or just enjoying the world, we hope these updates make your journey even more fun.



Please do check out the full patch notes below 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684481/5566c7277ae05bbb1c9c0b511b0796e604908234.jpg"]
Patch 1 Notes – Steam
Tarik Upih Animation

Fixed: Tarik Upih now displays the correct in-air animation when airborne.

Bike Camera Improvements

Auto-centering camera is now disabled by default.

Bike camera is now fully controllable.

Trophy System Bug

Fixed an issue preventing trophies from unlocking properly.

Nighttime Lighting

Improved nighttime lighting for better atmosphere and visibility.

RC Car Racing

Added player indicators for both Upin and Ipin in RC car racing.

RC units no longer collide with players, and players no longer block each other.

Save System

Improved save system stability.

Reduced the risk of data corruption.

“Chef Ehsan” Quest

Made it significantly easier to achieve the “Perfect Chef” ranking.

Fixed dialogue freeze during the “Chef Ehsan” quest.

NPCs Near Water

Fixed an issue where NPCs would appear near rivers and ponds.

General Fixes

General bug fixes and polish based on player feedback and internal testing.

General Visuals

Enhanced motion blur and TAA for smoother visuals and reduced ghosting.

Jumping Animation

Fixed T-pose issue when jumping onto beds.

Note: Existing progress and saved data remain unaffected.

Thank you for playing and supporting Upin & Ipin Universe! Keep sharing your feedback, it helps us make the game even better.
